title: Race, the French Quarter and the studio's reputation
summary: Matassa grew up in a mixed neighborhood; some in New Orleans, including a hypocritical attorney and white union musicians, called his studio a black studio though he recorded many white sessions.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
